issues.description: push_error is called with a keyword arg that may not match the method signature
issues.detail: The new code calls `await self.push_error(error_msg=f"Error: {error_msg}")`. Most Pipecat services define `push_error(self, error: ErrorFrame)` and expect a frame, not a string kwarg. If this signature is wrong, every error path raises TypeError instead of surfacing the error. Verify the actual signature in the base class.

issues.description: Duplicate 'transcriber_error' entry in the message_type tuple
issues.detail: The tuple at lines 725-739 lists `"transcriber_error"` twice. Harmless but signals a copy/paste mistake and suggests the author may have intended a different value (e.g., `transcription_error`) for one of the slots. Worth deduping and double-checking against the ElevenLabs docs list.

issues.description: Removing the try/except around _process_messages may now propagate exceptions that previously were swallowed
issues.detail: Previously `_receive_messages` wrapped `_process_messages` in try/except and logged on disconnect. Now any exception from the `async for` loop (e.g., ConnectionClosed, network errors) propagates to the caller in websocket_service. The PR claims this fixes an infinite loop, but the caller's reconnect loop behavior should be verified to ensure it actually exits/reconnects correctly rather than tight-looping on a different exception.

issues.description: Generic error messages lose per-type context that previously distinguished auth/quota errors
issues.detail: The old code logged distinct messages like `ElevenLabs auth error:` and `Quota exceeded:` and pushed labeled error frames. The new consolidated branch logs nothing (no logger.error call) and always prefixes with `Error:`. Downstream consumers and log filters that relied on the old labels will see a regression in observability.
`changelog/3233.fixed.md` ends without a final newline (`\ No newline at end of file`). Minor style nit but trivial to fix and keeps the changelog directory consistent.

issues.description: Fallback error string uses 'Unknown error - {message_type}' which may mask the real payload
issues.detail: When `data.get("error")` returns None, the fallback embeds the message_type. That's fine, but the ElevenLabs error payload field may not always be named `error` across the new error types listed (e.g., `quota_exceeded_error`, `rate_limited`). Worth confirming the payload schema for each type so messages aren't silently 'Unknown error'.

review.summary: The PR consolidates ElevenLabs STT error handling and removes a try/except that caused an infinite reconnect loop on websocket disconnect. The core fix is sensible, but the consolidated error branch contains a duplicate `transcriber_error` entry, drops the per-type log lines that aided observability, and relies on `push_error(error_msg=...)` whose signature should be verified against the base class. The changelog file also lacks a trailing newline. Worth confirming reconnect behavior in the caller now that exceptions propagate out of `_receive_messages`.
